description: Small synthetic evidence benchmark for local model comparison. Expected facts require manual review; this is not a production accuracy score.

cases.question: Which database and Python driver does the admin panel use?

sources.text:
# Components
## Admin panel
Stores dealer records in PostgreSQL. The Python API uses asyncpg.
## Chat search
Embeddings are stored in Pinecone; this is separate from the admin database.

cases.expected: PostgreSQL and asyncpg; must not answer Pinecone.

history.question: What happens when I upload a PDF to the image endpoint?
history.answer: The image endpoint rejects the PDF with HTTP 415.

cases.expected: Resolve it to the image endpoint and that to PDF; explain PDF is outside png/jpg allowlist, causing 415.

cases.question: What is the final decision on the timeout: 15 or 30 seconds?

sources.text: Monday: Proposal: reduce the worker timeout to 15 seconds. Needs load-test review.
Tuesday final decision: retain 30 seconds. The 15-second proposal is rejected because batch jobs legitimately take 20 seconds.

cases.expected: 30 seconds, cites final discussion, identifies 15 as a rejected proposal.
